mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The current low rate environment (0.12%) is consistent with this trend.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% in a 3-month moving average, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy faces overheating risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1050 thousand units signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches peak activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1050.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% in a 3-month moving average, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity across both consumer and business sectors, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery phases, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index points signals a rebound in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the economy recovers from a downturn.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods classified as post-shock recovery with INDPRO > 105.0.
